subject: Lisan writer's pass posted (both tracks): the pass, the LAG-1K story map, the sandworm card, the C13-04 brief for your mode and cost check, the two-doors card, decisions and grades, Story 01 and five seeds; reviewed and hashed
body:
Hello Nova. The Lisan writer's pass is written in `lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/` (START_HERE.txt first). It fulfils Ziggy's four decisions (b912ca65, 9bb48281) and the two-track direction relayed by Personal Nova (b0cb2b62, 5a11c3a4; my acknowledgement 5aa7b0ec). Everything is a proposal: nothing accepted, timed, generated, tagged or spent. Your six CFA files in the folder are untouched and listed in START_HERE as CFA-owned.

**Track A (song).** `WRITER_PASS_001.md`: the spine is two worlds, one face: the LAG-1K desert is the outer-world A-line where his body stays in the signature look; the fifty panels are the mirror B-line where he is everyone; the mirror is the only door between them; one change per chorus return; panel 50 joins them. Jet placed with the five cards as recorded, plus a proposal for the unplaced JET-03 (the thumper as the first action Lisan chooses). Card order: sandworm, two doors, mirror, grind, creation, inward, Jet. `LAG1K_STORY_MAP.md` assigns all 43 categories to sections with the team's NOTES picks, for HaL's shortlist and your catalog grouping. `SCENE_CARD_SANDWORM.md` (SW-1 thumper, SW-2 the rise from C13-04, SW-3/4 alternates that flip the worm's side, SW-5 panel 10). `PROTOTYPE_BRIEF_C13-04.md`: the eleven fields for the first Lisan clip, Flow and Gemini as two routes, **ready for your mode and cost check**; the source's inherited defects (disc eye absent, snake-like worms, no piercings) are recorded separately from what motion may change. `SCENE_CARD_TWO_DOORS.md` (panels 48 to 50 as the ending; two new beats proposed). `DECISIONS_20261012.md`: Ziggy's decisions, the standing record, nine open items, my attributed grades for twelve viewed images.

**Track B (standalone).** `STORY_01_JET_BLACK_INTRODUCTION.md` ("The Gloved Hand", nine scenes, about seven minutes by story design, every scene keyed to an archive category, canon named, new things labeled, Jet to REF-02's build) and `STORY_SEEDS_20261012.md` (five connected seeds; seed 05 is the bridge to the song).

**Findings for CFA (full-size checks, not decisions):** the LAG-1K identity text never named the three silver piercings and the seven drafts I viewed have none (Ziggy's decision: bare desert look, or a bounded repair pass); panels 48, 49 and 50 all carry the brow ring and ear hoop on his right with the nostril hoop on his left (one repair brief); SC-10's ear hoop reads on his right; the LAG-1K set has no catalog entry and `catalog.js` has no C13-04, so HaL's storyboard_prime tag waits on your entry; eyes drift grey or brown in several desert drafts.

**Correction of fact, repeated from 5aa7b0ec:** I do not hold the Meta Mirror lyrics; the Grok team's TIPS.md says Ziggy shared them in their group chat on October 11 as a mood reference. If Ziggy confirms that chat is the source, I will bring the text over as a provisional lyric file with provenance for your intake record; every timestamp stays null regardless.

**Review:** one read-only reviewer over the Track A files (16 findings: three truncated cue quotes, one fail-share claim, viewed-image counts, attributions of two rules, a JET-04 staging attribution, an Omni Flash resolution claim; all fixed) and one canon reviewer over the Track B files (10 findings: unlabeled proposed rules and stagings, a cannot/will-not contradiction between story and seeds, one franchise word in prose, one C36 pick; all fixed). Hashes below are after the fixes.

**Requests to HaL (proposals only, none sent as a generation request):** a C13-04 repair variant for the production clip; worm-screen-left alternates; a C15 thumper frame with the reference's eye color; the 48/49/50 piercing repair; a throat-eye macro; C36 tower frames in the signature wardrobe. They wait for Ziggy. Image requests go through the Pent House when he says go; presentation to him goes through your library.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 00:24 UTC
